meta.title: Navarino · Restaurant & Café on the beach in Xylokastro
meta.description: A beachfront restaurant and all-day café at Patron 108, Xylokastro. Coffee and brunch in the morning, Greek home cooking, grill and seafood late into the evening.
meta.menuDescription: Navarino's menu: coffee and brunch, home-cooked dishes, grill and seafood, desserts.

morning.title: Mornings on the water
morning.body: The first freddo of the day on the ledge, next to the pot of basil. The sea is still calm and the blue floor still cool. From early on we serve coffee, brunch and sweet crêpes, for anyone who likes the day to start slowly.

day.title: A day by the sea
day.intro: From the first coffee to the last glass, Navarino changes colour with the gulf.

panels.title: Midday by the water
panels.text: A swim, a plate, the whole gulf in front of you.

panels.title: Sunset
panels.text: The sky over the Corinthian Gulf turns orange.

panels.title: The lights come on
panels.text: Tables are set and the sea turns green.

daily.label: Dish of the day
daily.hint: Ask us what else was cooked today

kitchen.title: What the sea brings, what the grill fires
kitchen.body: Home cooking with the patience of the pot, charcoal for the octopus and the meats, fresh seafood and seasonal vegetables. Tastes of Greece, the way they taste at a family table.
kitchen.dishCaption: Grilled over charcoal, with fava and lemon.
kitchen.passCaption: On the pass, moments before they reach the terrace.

menuTeaser.title: From morning until late
menuTeaser.body: Coffee and brunch, dishes of the day, grill, seafood and desserts.

house.title: A white house with a blue floor
house.body: Whitewashed walls, white pergolas and a floor painted the blue of the Aegean. Inside, mint-green wooden tables, fuchsia cushions and rattan lamps. Glass walls all around, so the sea is never out of sight.

story.title: A name from the sea
story.body: On 20 October 1827, in the bay of Navarino at Pylos, the fleets of Britain, France and Russia defeated the Ottoman-Egyptian fleet. The battle opened the way to Greek independence. Almost two hundred years later the name is still travelling, all the way here, to a house on the water.
story.boatCaption: The old boat, on the pebbles in front of us.
story.ownerTodo: TODO: The owners' details and their own story. To be supplied by the client only.

evening.title: When the sea turns emerald
evening.body: At dusk the lights beneath the water come on and the bay in front of us glows green. A little later, the moon rises over the Corinthian Gulf.
